name: legend-chip
title: Initials chip and legend
notes: Initials carry the floor's own sticker colours from src/config/legend.json (JA blue, JS pink, JG orange, AK green, LB purple; JAN is an alias of JA). Initials that are not mapped stay neutral and are never given a guessed identity. The same chip is the legend in the header (with a visible caption, Initials) and the initials on each job card. Ink on every tint is 7:1 or better in both themes; the tints are low chroma on purpose.
